name: Gleaning Our Future
summary: Prospector Whelgar sees a chance to learn more from the Goaz Stone. Four larger golems bear inscriptions that match its missing pieces.

sections.title: Four Inscriptions
sections.body: You've found missing pieces of the Goaz Stone. Whelgar points to four larger golems bearing the names Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru. He asks you to use the stone near each one and bring their hearts back to him, hoping they will reveal more of its markings.

sections.title: Faint Words
sections.body: When Whelgar brings the hearts close to the Goaz Stone, new writing appears in a faint shimmer: “Curse of Flesh... they will fail.” He cannot make out what the words mean and wants to take the stone somewhere safe for further study.

faq.q: What does Whelgar want me to bring back?
faq.answer: Whelgar asks you to bring back the hearts of Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru after using the Goaz Stone near each golem.

aliases: where are ados modr golm neru
faq.answer: Ados is at the Dragonmaw Gates near Grim Batol. Modr is just outside Dun Modr to the north. Golm lies beneath Grim Batol, east of Dun Algaz. Neru is behind Direforge Hill to the northeast.

faq.q: Why does Whelgar want the golem hearts?
faq.answer: The golems bear inscriptions matching missing pieces of the Goaz Stone, and Whelgar hopes their hearts will reveal more of the stone.

faq.q: What does Whelgar think of the golems?
faq.answer: Whelgar suspects the constructs will be tougher than the warder.

attribution: In-game quest text: Gleaning Our Future
